variables.name: COLORFILTER_TINT_COLOR_CONTROL_NORMAL
variables.comment:
* Drawables which should be tinted with the value of {@code R.attr.colorControlNormal},
     * using the default mode using a raw color filter.

variables.name: TINT_COLOR_CONTROL_NORMAL
variables.comment:
* Drawables which should be tinted with the value of {@code R.attr.colorControlNormal}, using
     * {@link DrawableCompat}'s tinting functionality.

variables.name: COLORFILTER_COLOR_CONTROL_ACTIVATED
variables.comment:
* Drawables which should be tinted with the value of {@code R.attr.colorControlActivated},
     * using a color filter.

variables.name: COLORFILTER_COLOR_BACKGROUND_MULTIPLY
variables.comment:
* Drawables which should be tinted with the value of {@code android.R.attr.colorBackground},
     * using the {@link android.graphics.PorterDuff.Mode#MULTIPLY} mode and a color filter.

variables.name: TINT_COLOR_CONTROL_STATE_LIST
variables.comment:
* Drawables which should be tinted using a state list containing values of
     * {@code R.attr.colorControlNormal} and {@code R.attr.colorControlActivated}

variables.name: TINT_CHECKABLE_BUTTON_LIST
variables.comment:
* Drawables which should be tinted using a state list containing values of
     * {@code R.attr.colorControlNormal} and {@code R.attr.colorControlActivated} for the checked
     * state.
